schema_documentation:
Identical 3-key schema to `common_corpus/ell_Grek` — `text` (str, 100%), `id` (str, 100%), `metadata` (dict, 100%) — and the same 18 metadata sub-keys, all 100% present: `name`(=common_corpus), `collection`, `open_type`, `license`, `date`, `title`, `creator`, `language`(=`grc`… see notes), `language_type`(=Spoken), `language_score`, `language_script`(=Grek), `word_count`, `token_count`, `url`(=`id`), `dataset`, `file_path`, `shard_id`, `__index_level_0__`.

Measured distributions over 1,521 records: `collection` — Greek-PD 87.2%, US-PD-Books 6.2%, Multilingual-PD 3.4%, German-PD 1.5%, French-PD-diverse 0.7%, Italian-PD 0.7%, French-Science-Pile 0.3% (README: Greek-PD 86.9 / US-PD-Books 6.8 / Multilingual-PD 3.8 / German-PD 1.2 — verified). `license` ≈ Public Domain 99.9%. `date` range 1503–2023 (README said 1506–1971 — corrected at both ends). `title` and `creator` are real bibliographic strings here (unlike Eurlex).
